# Jimwel Cruz

> Full-stack developer and web team lead based in the Philippines, building performant, user-friendly digital experiences with React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, and Shopify since 2023.

## About

Jimwel Cruz is a full-stack developer proficient in React, Next.js, and Node.js since 2023. From e-commerce stores to interactive web apps, he helps take products from ideation and wireframing through prototyping to final delivery, while leading a development team and mentoring teammates.

## Services

- Full-Stack Development: Building complete, production-ready web applications from database to user interface.
- E-commerce Development: Creating Shopify and custom online stores that convert visitors into customers.
- UI Implementation: Turning designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using modern frameworks.
- Performance Optimization: Improving load times and Lighthouse scores for a faster, smoother experience.
- Accessibility Audits: Reviewing and fixing usability so everyone can navigate and use your website.
- Responsive Design: Designing websites that look and perform equally well on all devices and screen sizes.
